culotte.modesDesc: The 20 questions are the same in both cases. On your own, you see who decides more in your eyes. Together, you each answer separately and you find out whether you agree.
culotte.modeSoloDesc: You answer based on what really happens at home.
culotte.modeDuoDesc: Take turns on the same phone, without seeing each other's answers.
culotte.setupTitreSolo: Who wears the pants in your relationship?
culotte.setupDescSolo: The quiz asks 20 questions about everyday decisions, for example tonight's movie or the vacation. For each question, say who decides more often: you, your partner or both of you equally.
culotte.setupTitreDuo: Who wears the pants in your relationship?
culotte.setupDescDuo: Enter your names. The first person answers the 20 questions and then hands over the phone. The result shows you who decides more and whether you agree on it.
culotte.avertissement: Go with what really happens at home and not with what you'd like to be true. It's a game, there's no right answer!
culotte.relaisDebut: Answer without letting the other see the screen.
culotte.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Hand over the phone. Their answers stay hidden until the result.
culotte.balanceLegende: Each person's share of the decisions, based on your answers
culotte.r_egal_d: At your place, nobody's the boss and you split the decisions almost evenly. For example, one of you picks the movie and the other the vacation. You talk the rest through. According to a Pew Research Center survey in the US, that's the case for about one couple in three.
culotte.r_egal_d_solo: In your eyes, nobody's the boss and you split the decisions almost evenly. Now it remains to be seen whether {{autre}} sees it the same way. Take the quiz together to find out!
culotte.r_unPeu_t: {{nom}} wears the pants a little more
culotte.r_unPeu_d: The scale tips slightly toward {{nom}}. {{nom}} is more often the one who chooses or gets the last word. That's the case for lots of couples. It works fine as long as {{autre}} still has a say on what matters most to them.
culotte.r_unPeu_d_solo: In your eyes, the scale tips slightly toward {{nom}}. {{nom}} is more often the one who chooses or gets the last word. If that suits you, all good. If not, say which things you'd like to decide a little more often.
culotte.r_unPeu_t_vous: You wear the pants a little more
culotte.r_unPeu_d_vous: Going by your answers, you're slightly more often the one who chooses or gets the last word. Ask {{autre}} if that's okay with them. Some people are happy not to decide everything. Others would like to be asked more often.
culotte.r_plus_d: On most decisions, {{nom}} makes the call. It can work very well if {{autre}} doesn't like deciding and {{nom}} doesn't mind. Talk about it together anyway. The one who decides everything sometimes gets tired of it, and so does the one who never decides anything.
culotte.r_plus_d_solo: In your eyes, {{nom}} makes most of the decisions at your place. If you'd like more of a say, start with one specific thing, for example the vacation. It goes down better than one big complaint.
culotte.r_plus_t_vous: You're the one who wears the pants
culotte.r_plus_d_vous: Going by your answers, you're mostly the one who decides, whether it's the outings or the budget. If that suits {{autre}}, great. Ask them now and then anyway. When you decide everything, you also carry everything that goes wrong on your own.
culotte.accordTitre: Do you agree on who decides?
culotte.accordTexte: You agree on {{n}} questions out of {{total}}.
culotte.accordHaut: You see your relationship the same way. At your place, everyone knows who decides what.
culotte.accordMoyen: On the rest, you each have your own version. That's very common, because we remember the decisions we made better than the ones we left to the other.
culotte.accordBas: You don't see things the same way at all. The questions where you disagree will make good things to talk about!
culotte.chacunMoiTitre: You each think you're the one who decides
culotte.chacunMoiNote: On these questions, you each answered “Me”.
culotte.chacunAutreTitre: You each think the other one decides
culotte.chacunAutreNote: On these questions, you each pointed at the other. Nobody wants to decide!
culotte.invitationDuo: It's even more fun together. You each answer separately and you'll see whether {{autre}} agrees with you.
culotte.toutTitre: All your answers, side by side
culotte.q1: Who picks the movie or the show at night?
culotte.q3: Who picks the music in the car?
culotte.q4: Who chooses where you go on vacation?
culotte.q5: Who has the final say on the decor?
culotte.q6: Who keeps track of the money?
culotte.q7: Who decides on the big purchases?
culotte.q8: Who plans the weekends and the outings?
culotte.q9: Who says “okay, time to go” at the end of a night out?
culotte.q10: Who decides when the lights go off?
culotte.q12: Who finds it easier to say no?
culotte.q13: Who gets the last word in an argument?
culotte.q14: Who gets their way more often?
culotte.q15: Who organizes the dinners and the invitations?
culotte.q16: Who had the final say on where you live?
culotte.q17: Who drives when you go somewhere together?
culotte.q18: Who decides it's time to tidy up or clean?
culotte.q19: Who makes the call when you have to decide fast?
culotte.q20: Who gets the big projects started, like taking a trip or getting a pet?
